newsitem.title: USA: Muni yields mostly unchanged over week -- Delphis.
newsitem.headline: Muni yields mostly unchanged over week -- Delphis.

text.p: Municipal bond yields were mostly unchanged in the week ended Thursday, Delphis Hanover Corp said Friday.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated municipal yields were unchanged at 5.60 percent, after falling five basis points the week before. Thirty-year Baa yields rose five basis points to 6.45 percent.

Munis outperformed Treasuries over the period, as the government long bond rose eight basis points by the close Thursday to 6.83 percent from 6.75 percent. The long bond has added 24 basis points over the past three weeks.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated munis were yielding 82 percent of the Treasury long bond at the close Thursday, compared to 83 percent the week before.

Average yields on one-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds were unchanged at 3.70 percent, after rising five basis points the week before, while Baa-rated one-years were up five basis points to 4.55 percent.
In the intermediate sector, ten-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds were unchanged at 4.90 percent for the second consecutive week, and Baa-rated ten-years held steady at 5.80 percent.
The municipal yield curve was unchanged for the week after flattening the prior week.
The triple-A and Baa yield curves between one-year and 30-year munis were both unchanged at 190 basis points.

The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years widened five basis points to 85 basis points, after narrowing five the prior week. The 30-year spread was also five wider, at 85 basis points.
